items.definition:
a person born during a baby boom, especially one born in the years following World War II
My grandparents are baby boomers, born in the 1950s.

a savagely violent person or animal
He was described as a brute for his cruel actions.

disguise or concealment, especially by means of paint, nets, or foliage
The chameleon's skin provides excellent camouflage against the leaves.

the outermost part of the sun's atmosphere; a crown-like structure
During a total solar eclipse, the sun's corona becomes visible.

the practice of dressing up as a character from a work of fiction
Many fans enjoy creating elaborate cosplay costumes for comic conventions.

cardiopulmonary resuscitation
Learning CPR can save a life in an emergency.

a famous female singer; a temperamental person
She was a talented singer, but her diva behavior made her difficult to work with.

grace and style
Her dress had an air of timeless elegance.

a substance or thing used to fill a space or gap
The dentist used a white filler to repair the tooth.

a slight obscuration of the lower atmosphere; a state of mental confusion
A thick haze hung over the city, reducing visibility.

a plant of the cannabis family, used to make rope, cloth, and paper
Hemp fibers are used to produce strong and durable textiles.

a temporary difficulty or problem; a knot or loop
We encountered a slight hitch in our plans, but it was quickly resolved.

the act of intruding; an unwelcome entry
She felt the constant media attention was an unwelcome intrusion into her private life.

a word or phrase that is significant or important
When searching online, use relevant keywords to get better results.

a means of securing the necessities of life
Farming is the main livelihood for many people in this region.

medical professional; paramedic
The medic quickly attended to the injured runner.

an act of canceling or nullifying
The committee voted for an override of the mayor's veto.

a form of oxygen in the atmosphere
The ozone layer protects us from harmful UV radiation.

a scientist who studies physics
Albert Einstein was a renowned theoretical physicist.

a word that can replace a noun
In the sentence 'She ran fast,' 'she' is a pronoun.

a stable subatomic particle with a positive charge
A proton is found in the nucleus of an atom.

a revised design or plan
The company announced a complete redesign of its logo.

unwillingness or hesitation
There was a noticeable reluctance among the team to accept the new rules.

a rotating part of a machine
The helicopter's main rotor began to spin rapidly.

a state of readiness or waiting
The emergency services are on standby for the storm.

a person who develops theories
She is a leading theorist in the field of quantum physics.

a soldier in a cavalry or armored unit; a state police officer
The state trooper pulled over the speeding car.

a small tower on top of a larger tower or at the corner of a building or wall
The castle had several turrets overlooking the valley.

a Black religious cult practiced in the Caribbean and the southern US, combining elements of Roman Catholic ritual with traditional African magical and religious rites
Some people believe in voodoo magic.

the practice of magic, especially black magic; the use of spells and the invocation of spirits
In ancient times, some people were accused of witchcraft.

a young bull
The farmer used a bullock to pull the plow.

the state of being a candidate for an office or position
Her candidacy for mayor was announced last week.

a usual or ordinary thing
Smartphones have become a commonplace item in daily life.

a device or program that changes something from one form to another
You might need a currency converter when traveling abroad.

the action of evading something
His tax evasion led to serious legal trouble.

the action of expelling someone from a property
The family faced eviction after failing to pay rent.

the action of forcing someone to leave an organization or place
His bad behavior led to his expulsion from school.

foul or dirty matter
The room was covered in filth and dust.

plant leaves, collectively
The autumn foliage in the mountains was beautiful.

a period of two weeks
I'll be away on holiday for a fortnight.

a person who kicks (especially in sports); a surprising or significant element
The kicker scored the winning field goal.

grain (usually barley) that has been steeped, germinated, and dried
Malt is a key ingredient in beer production.

the quality or state of being conscious or aware of something
Practicing mindfulness can reduce stress.

a person who presides over a discussion or meeting
The moderator kept the debate fair and orderly.

a person new to a field or activity
He is still a novice at playing the guitar.

a notice of a death, especially in a newspaper
I read his obituary in the local newspaper.

a person or team that qualifies for a competition; a word or phrase that qualifies another
The team won their last match and became a qualifier for the championship.

the action of replacing someone or something with another
The coach made a substitution in the second half of the game.

the trunk of the human body
The artist sculpted the figure's torso in clay.

a belt of the heavens within which are the apparent paths of the sun, moon, and major planets
What's your zodiac sign?

the act of leaving a place, person, or thing permanently
The abandonment of the old factory led to its decay.

the criminal act of deliberately setting fire to property
The police are investigating the fire as a case of arson.

a person who bats in baseball or cricket
The opening batsman scored a century in the first innings.

a prolonged period of drinking alcohol
He went on a weekend bender after finishing his exams.

the giving or offering of a bribe
The politician was accused of bribery and corruption.

a divine rule, especially one of the Ten Commandments
Thou shalt not steal is a well-known commandment.

a person who is responsible for a crime or other misdeed
The police are still searching for the culprit behind the robbery.

a departure from the usual or accepted standard
Any deviation from the plan must be reported immediately.

a lack of trust
There was a growing distrust between the two political parties.

the customary code of polite behavior in society or among members of a particular profession or group
Dining etiquette varies greatly between cultures.

a guard over the wheel of a vehicle; a type of guitar
The car's fender was dented in the accident.

a man to whom one is engaged to be married
My fiance and I are planning our wedding for next year.

a narrow valley between hills or mountains, typically with steep rocky walls and a stream running through it
The river carved a deep gorge through the mountains.

a person who pretends to have virtues, moral or religious beliefs, principles, etc., that he or she does not actually possess
He called his opponent a hypocrite for saying one thing and doing another.
